privateProvenanceBoundary: The root-owned certificate execution receipt and its runtime paths remain separate provenance; their omission here does not enlarge the static theorem or claim a portable execution.

quantifiers.acceptedChartBoundary: The accepted-execution direction uses the parser/EA and tau/range contracts to establish the normalized chart state Sc(tau)=1 before applying the consumer identity; it does not require an advice-honesty premise.
quantifiers.acceptedExecution: For every accepted execution satisfying the existing RD/EA/tau/range guards and named source-to-byte, field, caller, line-factor, and typed-RO contracts, the implication uses no honest-advice, honest-producer, canonical-construction, or resource-budget premise.
quantifiers.canonicalCompleteness: The separate existence direction uses the existing canonical finite producer to provide normalized witnesses and the separately proved all-row resource bounds. This premise is not imported into accepted-execution soundness.

residualScope: Still conditional on the named field/domain, typed-RO, line-factor, source-to-byte/lowering, caller-frame, fixed-VK, and canonical-completeness contracts. No arbitrary-advice, arbitrary-VK, privacy, application, network, maintainer, official, qualification, score, or publication claim.
scope: Portable static source/proof composition only; no source imports, VM, compiler, prover, benchmark, fixture, or new arithmetic execution. The private execution receipt is intentionally kept outside this portable proof.

transition.eventExponent: Pinned NAF factorSchedule/cPoly contributes [Sc]^-m with m=6u+2.
transition.finalExponent: lambda mod r=0, hence FE(g)=1 because the final-exponent image has order dividing r.
transition.glsUse: GLS is used only through sum_i u_i*pi_i-PI_SUM_OFFSET = n (mod r), then fixed-VK bilinearity supplies the four-pair equation; no stronger K*/E* equality is asserted.
transition.initialClass: Fp=Sc(-z), Fm=Sc(z); pneg(a)=a(-X)=sigma(a); the accepted chart contract gives Sc(tau)=1, so [Sc] is defined.
transition.stateBoundaryW: The nonterminal runRange boundary W is the next committed state polynomial; protocol.mjs line 190 evaluates that state at +/-z and updates R before continuing. It is distinct from terminal Frobenius W.
transition.terminalExponent: At terminal Pfin, psubst(Sc,ETA) contributes [Sc]^(p^2); non-c factors, Rconst, and the actual GLS fold are grouped into the actual raw constituent g.
transition.terminalFrobW: The terminal script t:W span evaluates Frob(Sc) at +/-z and +/-eta*z and multiplies the paired evaluations; this terminal W contributes [Sc]^(p+p^3).
